paragraphs.source_en: In this example, the seller's use of Need-payoff Questions has allowed the buyer to explain the payoff and, as a result, to find the solution more acceptable. Need-Payoff Questions Rehearse the Customer for Internal Selling In smaller sales your success rests on how effectively you can convince the person you sell to, but this is not always the case in larger sales. As the size of the decision grows, more people become involved. Your suc cess may often depend not just on how you sell, but on how well the people in the account sell to each other. In the small sale you're usually there during the whole sales process. But in larger sales there are likely to be many "sales calls" where influencers and users sell internally on your behalf and where there's no opportunity for you to be present.
